related_questions.question: Is it safe to go to the Czech Republic right now?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it is generally safe to travel to the Czech Republic. The Czech Republic is considered a safe destination with a low crime rate, though petty crime like pickpocketing can occur in tourist areas. Normal safety precautions are advised, and there are no specific COVID-19 related entry restrictions.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, it is generally safe to travel to the Czech Republic

list.title: Safety:
list.snippet: The Czech Republic is ranked highly in the Global Peace Index, indicating a low risk of violence and crime.

list.title: Petty Crime:
list.snippet: While violent crime is low, be aware of petty theft, especially in crowded tourist areas and on public transportation.

list.title: Scams:
list.snippet: Be cautious of street money exchangers and other scams, particularly in Prague.

list.title: COVID-19:
list.snippet: There are currently no COVID-19 related restrictions for entry into the Czech Republic.

list.title: Terrorism:
list.snippet: The Czech Republic is not considered a high-risk terrorism target, but be aware of your surroundings and exercise normal precautions, as terrorist attacks can occur anywhere.

list.title: Demonstrations:
list.snippet: Public protests can occur, so be mindful of your surroundings and avoid large crowds.

list.title: Transportation:
list.snippet: Be cautious when using public transportation, especially at night, and consider using regulated transportation options like taxis from your hotel.

list.title: Health:
list.snippet: The Czech Republic has a good healthcare system and offers a range of medical services.

list.title: Overall:
list.snippet: The Czech Republic is a popular tourist destination with a good safety record, but it's always wise to take precautions against petty crime and be aware of your surroundings.

text_blocks.snippet: While the World Health Organization (WHO) declared an end to the COVID-19 Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 5, 2023, COVID-19 continues to circulate.
